articles.title: How a Slave Girl's Quest for Knowledge Became 2026's Must-Watch Historical Anime
articles.summary: Sold into slavery, Sitara plots revenge when Mongols invade 13th-century Persia. But her journey takes an unexpected turn: learning becomes her power. This anime blends rigorous history with Disney-esque cartoon flair, even casting real sumo wrestlers.

articles.title: Olivia Wilde's 'The Invite' Crashes the Indie Box Office with a $56K Per-Screen Average
articles.summary: Opening on just 7 screens, Olivia Wilde's 'The Invite' raked in over $393,000, averaging a stunning $56,194 per theater. It's outpacing recent A24 darlings and proving that a limited release can still generate massive buzz.

articles.title: Hudson Film Festival Expands with Sundance Winners, Ghibli Magic, and a Youth Workshop
articles.summary: The fourth Hudson Film Festival (Aug 6-9) unveils a 25-film lineup featuring Sundance awardees like 'Filipiñana' and 'Barbara Forever,' plus a 'Spirited Away' screening. It expands to Catskill, NY, and offers a free filmmaking workshop for grades 6-8.
